rules.description: Free, prior and informed consent (FPIC) or equivalent agreement must be documented
rules.remediation: Execute a documented FPIC process or land-use agreement with affected Indigenous communities before land disturbance.

rules.description: A stakeholder engagement plan must be maintained
rules.remediation: Prepare a stakeholder engagement plan with a stakeholder register, engagement schedule and disclosure commitments.

rules.description: A functioning grievance mechanism must be available to communities
rules.remediation: Establish an accessible grievance mechanism with defined response times and escalation paths; publicise it locally.

rules.description: Unresolved community grievances older than 90 days must be zero
rules.remediation: Prioritise resolution of aged grievances; assign owners and report progress to the community liaison committee.

rules.description: A cultural heritage survey must be completed before ground disturbance
rules.remediation: Commission a cultural heritage survey with traditional owners and register avoidance zones before clearing.

rules.description: Local employment share should meet the committed target (%)
rules.remediation: Implement local hiring and training programs to reach the committed local employment share.
